description: Original full license supplements for actual shipped package/vendor source. Per-file source notices are retained separately by the existing Connector build collector. A package or source hash change requires review.

components.name: React DOM Factories
components.evidence: The exact published react-dom-factories 1.0.2 package declares MIT, points to facebook/react, and retains its 2015-present Facebook copyright. Its tarball omits the declared LICENSE. This original full React MIT grant is from the same upstream released on the package publication date; the shipped source copyright remains unchanged.

components.name: fflate
components.evidence: zip-build/README.md declares fflate 0.8.3; zip-build/lib/fflate.js is byte-identical to the official npm 0.8.3 package esm/browser.js.

components.name: UglifyCSS adaptation
components.evidence: The installed vendor/css-minifier.js retains its original UglifyCSS/Franck Marcia MIT declaration; the full original upstream grant supplements that declaration without claiming the adapted code equals a particular unmodified release.

components.name: YUI Compressor adaptation
components.evidence: The installed vendor/css-minifier.js retains the exact 2011 Yahoo BSD declaration; the original full upstream 2011 license is preserved.

components.name: Srcset Parser adaptation
components.evidence: The installed vendor/html-srcset-parser.js retains its original Alex Bell MIT declaration; the full original upstream grant supplements it.

components.name: Stanford Javascript Crypto Library adaptation
components.evidence: zip-build/package-lock.json pins zip.js 2.8.60; its lib/core/streams/codecs/sjcl.js identifies the SJCL donor/authors and BSD/GPL choice, retained in vendor/zip/zip.js. This preserves the original SJCL full BSD grant and upstream licensing alternatives.
